reviews.outcome: No new serious defect found in these adopted passages. The corpus gives the finite-index compactness construction, distinguishes represented subsets and internal maps from external ones, and proves the set-domain satisfaction equivalence by formula induction. It does not infer a transitive model from consistency or introduce a global class truth predicate.
